text: The 'BARCELOS' mark on the shirt is the Município de Barcelos (Câmara Municipal de Barcelos), the town council of Barcelos: the council approved a sports-sponsorship contract with Gil Vicente FC whose funds are destined for the Município's institutional advertising on the shirts of the club's senior teams.
short: The Barcelos shirt mark is the town council, paying for advertising on the shirts.

source.name: Município de Barcelos: Câmara aprova 370 mil euros para subsídios a associações e contratos de patrocínio desportivo
source.quote: Estas verbas destinam-se publicidade institucional do Município nas camisolas das equipas seniores destes dois clubes, durante a época desportiva.
source.note: The same passage records the sports-sponsorship contracts approved with Gil Vicente FC (250,000 euros) and Óquei Clube de Barcelos (50,000 euros). English: these funds are destined for the Município's institutional advertising on the shirts of the senior teams of these two clubs, during the sports season.

additionalSources.name: E24: "Barcelos" nas camisolas do Gil e do Óquei
additionalSources.quote: verbas destinam-se publicidade institucional do Município nas camisolas das equipas seniores destes dois clubes
additionalSources.note: Named regional press (Cávado/Lima), quoting the council's announcement; the article names Gil Vicente and Óquei Clube de Barcelos as the two clubs.

additionalSources.name: Gil Vicente FC: Parceiros - Juntos pelo Gil
additionalSources.quote: Marcas, instituições e empresas que caminham connosco dentro e fora de campo.
additionalSources.note: The club's partners page lists Barcelos (cm-barcelos.pt, the Município de Barcelos) among its OFFICIAL SPONSORS, and the club store's back photo of the 2026-27 home shirt shows 'BARCELOS' across the upper back.
